gloss: way of incense; incense appreciation art

definitions.gloss: way of incense; art of incense appreciation
definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese art of appreciating fragrant wood and incense, with its own etiquette and games. Together with {茶道|さどう} (tea ceremony) and {華道|かどう} (flower arranging), it is one of the three classical refined arts.

examples.english: To study the way of incense.

examples.japanese: {香道|こうどう}では{香|こう}りを「{聞|き}く」と{言|い}う。
examples.english: In the way of incense, smelling a fragrance is called 'listening' to it.

examples.japanese: {香道|こうどう}は{茶道|さどう}や{華道|かどう}と{並|なら}ぶ{日本|にほん}の{伝統芸道|でんとうげいどう}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: The way of incense is one of Japan's traditional refined arts, alongside tea ceremony and flower arranging.

notes:
A refined art centered on appreciating the fragrance of {香木|こうぼく} (fragrant wood). Practitioners 'listen' ({聞|き}く) to scents rather than 'smell' them, and play identification games such as {組香|くみこう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {香道|こうどう}を{習|なら}う: to learn the way of incense
- {香|こう}を{聞|き}く: to 'listen' to (appreciate) incense

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {茶道|さどう}: tea ceremony — the way of tea, a sister refined art
- {華道|かどう}: flower arranging — the way of flowers, the third of the three arts
